name: Master of Machine Learning and Computer Vision
notes: Students without an identified supervisor/client approved for COMP8800 or COMP8830 by week 1 of their penultimate semester must complete COMP8715 to graduate.

The Academic Advice tab says MMLCV students must complete COMP8280 (as a substitute for COMP8260/COMP6250) before enrolling in the research project, TechLauncher or internship. The formal Program Requirements do not list COMP8280, so it is not modelled here.
The Academic Advice tab titles COMP8260 'Reponsible Practice: Innovation and Leadership'; the Program Requirements title 'Professional Practice: Responsible Innovation and Leadership' is used here.
The 18-unit Computer Vision and Machine Learning list overlaps the 24-unit core list; a course only counts once.
University electives must be courses offered to postgraduate students; undergraduate courses will not be credited.
Research-project students must take COMP6445 in first year (Semester 1 only). Internship/TechLauncher students should take COMP6442 in first year.

Credit/exemption: students with prior programming or maths study may get credit or exemption for introductory core courses; exempted courses must be replaced by elective COMP courses. Credit may shorten the degree (international students' eCoE will be revised).
No exit or transfer pathways are listed on the 2027 page.
